name: @jeswr/solid-sheets
description: Generated RDF workbook, sheet download and column descriptor models for Solid spreadsheets
author: Jesse Wright

scripts.build: pnpm -w exec tsc -p packages/solid-sheets/tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-generated.mjs
scripts.codegen: node node_modules/@jeswr/federation-codegen/dist/cli.js gen --ontology codegen/sheets.ontology.ttl --shapes codegen/sheets.shapes.ttl --config codegen/codegen.config.json --out src/generated
scripts.lint: pnpm -w exec biome check packages/solid-sheets/src packages/solid-sheets/scripts packages/solid-sheets/test packages/solid-sheets/codegen/codegen.config.json packages/solid-sheets/package.json
